content: Clipboard-clear defaults vary: NordPass defaults to 30s auto-clear; Bitwarden defaults to Never (user must opt in). Security advice consistently is to set a short clipboard TTL (~30-60s) rather than leave clipboard clearing off by default. Auto-lock timeout is a standard configurable setting (idle timeout, on-browser-restart, on-system-lock) across all major managers, but defaults favor convenience over security out of the box.
